title: Rapid RNA Analysis of Individual Caenorhabditis elegans
author: Ly, Reid, et al.
materials: A single worm was picked from an NGM plate using an eyelash pick and transferred to a drop of ∼20 μL of H2O to remove bacteria. The cleaned worm was transferred using the eyelash pick into 1 μL of worm lysis buffer (5 mM Tris pH 8.0 (Sigma–Aldrich), 0.5% Triton X-100 (Sigma–Aldrich), 0.5% Tween 20 (Bio-rad), 0.25 mM EDTA (Merck) and 1 mg/mL proteinase K (Roche)) on the wall of a 0.2 mL PCR tube. The tube was briefly centrifuged to bring the worm to the bottom of the tube and then incubated at 65 °C for 10 min in a thermocycler (Eppendorf). To inactivate proteinase K, the tube was heated to 85 °C for 1 min and then immediately cooled on ice. The worm lysate was used immediately for cDNA synthesis or stored below −70 °C. A single adult worm typically contained ∼35 ng total RNA, measured using Qubit RNA HS Assay kit (Life Technologies).

cDNA synthesis was performed using Maxima H Minus cDNA synthesis kit (Thermo Fisher) as described in the manufacturer’s manual. One microliter of cDNA synthesis mix was added to the worm lysate. The final mix contains 1× supplier-provided buffer, 0.5 mM each dNTP, 5 μM random hexamer, heat labile dsDNAse 1 unit/μL RNAse inhibitor and 20 unit/μL reverse transcriptase. The tube was briefly centrifuged, mixed, and incubated at 25 °C for 10 min, followed by 55 °C for 30 min and a final 85 °C for 5 min. The cDNA was diluted to 25 μL with H2O, used immediately or stored below −70 °C.

Quantitative PCR was performed using Roche LightCycler® 480 System. Each 10-μL reaction contained 0.5 μM each of forward and reverse primers, 0.1 μM hydrolysis probe, 1× Probes Master, and 2.5 μL of diluted cDNA. The primers for the quantification of the reference gene act-1 were manufactured by IDT and the sequences are: act1f (ACGCCAACACTGTTCTTTCC), act1r (GATGATCTTGATCTTCATGGTTGA), in 5′ → 3′ direction.

steps.title: Lyse single worm in buffer
steps.instruction: Pick a single worm, wash it, lyse it, and store the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Pick one worm from an NGM plate with an eyelash pick.
Transfer the worm to a ∼20 µL drop of H₂O to remove bacteria.
Move the cleaned worm into 1 µL worm lysis buffer (5 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.5 % Triton X‑100, 0.5 % Tween 20, 0.25 mM EDTA, 1 mg/mL proteinase K) on the wall of a 0.2 mL PCR tube.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to bring the worm to the bottom.
Incubate at 65 °C for 10 min in a thermocycler.
Heat to 85 °C for 1 min to inactivate proteinase K, then immediately place on ice.
Use the lysate immediately for cDNA synthesis or store at ≤ ‑70 °C.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from lysate
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the worm lysate using the Maxima H Minus kit.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL Maxima H Minus cDNA synthesis mix to the worm lysate (final mix contains 1× kit buffer, 0.5 mM each dNTP, 5 µM random hexamer, heat‑labile dsDNAse 1 U/µL, RNase inhibitor, and 20 U/µL reverse transcriptase).
Briefly centrifuge and mix the tube.
Incubate at 25 °C for 10 min.
Incubate at 55 °C for 30 min.
Incubate at 85 °C for 5 min to terminate the reaction.
Dilute the cDNA to a final volume of 25 µL with H₂O.
Use the diluted cDNA immediately or store at ≤ ‑70 °C.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Set up quantitative PCR reactions using the LightCycler 480 system.

substeps.instruction: For each 10 µL reaction combine: 0.5 µM forward primer, 0.5 µM reverse primer, 0.1 µM hydrolysis probe, 1× Probes Master, and 2.5 µL diluted cDNA.
Primers for the reference gene act‑1 (IDT): act1f (ACGCCAACACTGTTCTTTCC) and act1r (GATGATCTTGATCTTCATGGTTGA) (5'→3').
Load the reactions onto the Roche LightCycler® 480 and run the appropriate cycling program.

steps.title: Extract RNA using Trizol
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from worms with the Trizol method (alternative to direct lysis).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL Trizol to worms placed in a 1.5 mL tube and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 0.1 mL chloroform, shake vigorously for 15 s, then incubate at room temperature for 2–3 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube and add 0.25 mL isopropanol.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min, then centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 1 mL ice‑cold 70 % (v/v) ethanol.
Air‑dry the pellet and resuspend in RNase‑free H₂O (1 µL for a single worm; 100 µL for 100 worms).
Use 1 µL of the purified RNA for cDNA synthesis as described above.
